title.narrative: Development Planning and Capacity Building Programme of Gabon

description.narrative: Gabon is committed to promoting sustainable development through the achievement of the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). However, the country suffers from a weak planning chain, resulting in high costs such as disconnection between development planning and land use planning, poverty, and erratic and low economic growth, partly due to the closure of the Ministry of Planning since 2009. For strategic planning aligned with the SDGs, Gabon needs to establish a suitable ecosystem, including a renewed institutional framework, strengthened skills, established procedures and tools, and better coordination with and between sectoral departments and other key stakeholders. Strengthening the capacity of the newly created (February 2024) Ministry of Planning beyond its current structure will be an asset for development in line with the SDGs, ensuring an inclusive approach to development. The objective of this programme is to strengthen the core competencies of the Vice-Prime Minister's Office in charge of the Ministry of Planning and Foresight as well as civil society to analyse and identify the necessary reforms in policy and regulatory frameworks that improve strategic planning, strengthen governance, and enhance cross-sectoral collaboration and alignment, taking into account the SDGs as well as the key transitions, investment pathways to Deliver the SDGs. The goal is to establish a well-functioning modernized administration, with qualified and motivated staff, that is fit for an effective and efficient delivery of public services and a better use of the resources as expected by citizens and leaves no one behind.The enhanced Gabon’s strategic planning capacities of the “Commissariat Général au Plan” will enable an acceleration of SDGs progress by integrating the key transitions to save the SDGs in Gabon by 2030.
